name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, look, the weather's great again today, huh~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-stuff like that's nothing if you've got enough spirit!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Sis Nana's always all fired up, after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Your hands are cold, Macaron. Do you have poor circulation?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Poor circulation? Does that happen when it's cold?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't really get it, but then it's that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't they just cold from the weather...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Makes you want some gloves or something」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm fine! See, if I pull my hands inside like this, it's warm」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Synn, do you want gloves or anything?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Well, I could just knit some myself, I guess」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, you know how to knit?」

name: Synn
message: 「More or less, about as well as the average person」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll show you how much better I am at it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What about other stuff? Isn't there anything else you want?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, even if you ask me out of the blue...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you suddenly asking me that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn, Soba's tryin' to fish for info on somethin'」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way Nanaka would do something that roundabout」

name: Macaron
message: 「What are you gonna do after asking what Big Brother wants?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whatever Synn wants has nothing to do with me!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, Big Brother. Is there anything you want right now?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hm? Big Sis Nana, why are you panicking?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm telling you, it's just showing affection」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, age has nothing to do with it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you're basically our little sister, Mako」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, I am the Demon Lord, you know! Don't forget that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「More importantly, come on, if we don't hurry we're gonna be late」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Did you manage to ask Synn what he wants for his birthday--?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh... Well, you know, we're getting there, sort of, kind of...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm about to, okay, I'm about to!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then why don't you just go ahead and ask him right now--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh!? Ah, it's nothing, nothing at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Macaron. How's the part-time job going?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, glad to hear it, glad to hear it」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, what were Big Sis Nana and Big Sis Sacchin whispering about?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Could it be a continuation of this morning's talk?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no! It has nothing to do with that at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't need to hear anything about it, Synn!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Actually, Sacchin's been having trouble with cold sensitivity!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Sacchin-oneechan, you should follow my example and dress warmer too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, there's the warning bell. Should we head back to the classroom soon?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's not like I'm gonna wait around for you or anything, Onii-chan!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, since you went through the trouble of joining the Student Council~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You've gotta make use of that advantage~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You could at least casually ask what he wants for his birthday present, right~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it were that easy, I wouldn't be struggling.」

name: Macaron
message: 「A birthday... I wonder whose it is...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I'm studying for a test. I have one coming up soon」

name: Synn
message: 「It's basically a way to put your daily hard work to the test」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, I see. You guys have it tough with your lessons too, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「What was the school you went to in the Demon World like, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Private tutors used to come to the castle for me」

name: Synn
message: 「Aha, got it. Spoken like a true princess」

name: Macaron
message: 「Back then, I thought it was just normal, though...」

name: Macaron
message: 「In the end, Mama and Papa were just forcing it all on me」

name: Synn
message: 「You might feel that way now, but I'm sure it'll come in handy someday」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, I'm only able to live like I do now thanks to everything Mom and Dad taught me」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Sounds like you have a really nice Mama and Papa」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Though sometimes they're a little too lovey-dovey for my own good」

name: Macaron
message: 「More importantly, come on, you have to study properly, okay」

name: Macaron
message: 「Panda-chan, go over there so you don't get in the way, okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, Panda-chan. Is big brother's birthday coming up soon?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh? How does a shrimp like you know about that?」
